purpose: User-requested mechanics comparison against documented ASWING, retaining archive inventory separately.
selection: All nine original static-postprocessor curves and all 22 published ASW frequency cells in Table3. Mesh repeats, changed-gravity/medium diagnostics and the overlapping 200-slot archive inventory are excluded from this primary total.
qualifications: All 22 modal cells now have computed comparisons. The coupled 95Hz mode-label correspondence and thin-down printed 218-vs-21.8 conflict remain unpassed. Cross-ply and thin blades use documented physical-property reconstructions. For the strongly bent thin blade, first-torsion identification permits the root sign change described by Minguet pp127-128; activity and mesh/residual checks are unchanged. No reference value is removed or corrected.
